description: Where a person's income tax goes: the federal budget's spending (health, social security and welfare, defence, education...) and the part of their tax that goes to each, as the paycalculator.com.au tax expenditure page shows it. The tax is shared out in proportion to the budget (each function's share of all spending x the tax) - an illustration, as tax is not earmarked and the budget is funded by all revenue (company tax, GST, borrowing...); say so. Give the annual income tax from calculate_pay (tax.total.annual) when the person's pay has been calculated, otherwise a salary.

salary.description: Annual salary, when tax is not given: the tax is calculated for the current year (resident, super on top, no other income).

tax.description: Annual income tax (including the Medicare levy) - from calculate_pay when available.
